# 05-cell-kinds

Valid format 4 build. One table row with one cell of each kind: text, number, status, element, file, facet, and list.

A correct reader shows the row in the Overview view with seven cells.

- The text cell shows "handle". The number cell shows 4.
- The status cell shows "changed" with the status mark.
- The element cell shows "handle". A click opens the function `pkg.api.handle`.
- The file cell shows "api.py". A click opens the file `pkg/api.py` at line 12 in the code view.
- The facet cell shows "New code". A click applies the option `new` of the facet `part`.
- The list cell draws its six items as links, in order: text, number, status, element, file, and facet.
